# GetPhysicsHitDistance <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetPhysicsHitDistance:Float32
```

**Returns:** The value.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Gives how far from the start of the ray the hit is that the last `PhysicsRayCast`, `PhysicsSphereCast`, `PhysicsBoxCast`, `PhysicsCapsuleCast` or `PhysicsPointInside` found. A normal points out of the body, and the distance is how far from the start of the ray or shape the hit is, in units of the world. The values stay until the next such query and are 0 after one that found nothing.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
